title: Paper 45 executable experiment contract and output schemas

complex.const: exact inputs and residuals only: object with normalized reduced rational-string real and imag

dirichlet_power_ast.const: DIRICHLET_POWER envelope: base and exponent numerator/denominator are canonical integer strings; exact RFC8785 JCS UTF-8 and lowercase SHA-256 are stored

canonical_hash_input.const: UTF-8 LF-joined ordered_case_ids with one terminal LF

A.const: infinite_case_ids and infinite_records are exactly empty arrays

B.const: infinite_case_ids and infinite_records contain exactly ordered_case_ids in this order with no duplicate or extra

P.const: audited_case_ids and per_case_audits contain exactly ordered_case_ids in this order with no duplicate or extra

proof_hash_closure.const: for each case_id P copies B certificate_owner and the three hashes exactly; certificate_payload_sha256 is RFC8785 JCS SHA-256 of the B record with that field omitted

verdict_closure.const: P overall PASS iff every per-case verdict is PASS; otherwise overall HOLD

canonical_storage.const: store exact RFC8785 JCS UTF-8 string and its lowercase SHA-256; recompute both before acceptance

duplicate_member_detection.const: token-stream detection at every nesting depth before object construction

identity_scope.const: all declared target files and their declared parent directories

pointer_precondition.const: resolve target in fresh disposable copy and require JSON type and value equal value_from before replacement

ast_canonicalization_rule.const: duplicate-member token scan before object construction; validate canonical integer strings and reduced rationals; RFC8785-canonicalize unique-member objects; require stored JCS bytes and SHA-256 exact

finite_compression_pairing_rule.const: zip each finite-compression case.cutoffs with precision_bits in array order

infinite_coverage_rule.const: derive C-sorted INF IDs from case_registry and require exact ordered_case_ids; recompute ordered_set_sha256; require exact A/B/P arrays; reject missing extra duplicate reordered or undeclared INF case; close B-to-P owner/hash fields by case_id

interval_rule.const: parse finite decimals; require lower<=upper, matching precision_bits/width_target, and upper-lower<=width_target

rational_rule.const: parse p or p/q; denominator positive; gcd(abs(p),q)=1; zero serialized as 0
